name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
Google Material 3 (Material You) Overhaul: Entire mobile interface re-engineered from scratch with official Google M3 design tokens and responsive containers.
Pure AMOLED Default: Pitch-black #000000 OLED foundation with high-contrast surfaces for maximum battery efficiency and visual punch.
Flawless Dual Themes: Pixel-perfect light mode with crisp obsidian typography alongside deep AMOLED and obsidian dark modes.
Butter-Smooth 120 FPS: Replaced heavy multi-layer blurs and buggy negative spread box shadows with clean, hardware-accelerated M3 tonal elevations.
